meaning.meaning_en: This meme expresses passive-aggressive frustration or sarcastic disappointment regarding a specific annoyance. The first text box describes a problem or a hypothetical improvement, while the second box delivers the deadpan, unenthusiastic punchline 'that would be great' to highlight how ridiculous the situation is.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieses Meme drückt passive-aggressive Frustration oder sarkastische Enttäuschung über ein bestimmtes Ärgernis aus.
